name: Golden Grid by Kyungjun Lee
recipeDetail:
​​​​​​Comments from the Creator
The city never truly stops, yet there are fleeting moments when the sun hangs low and everything seems to pause and breathe. Golden Grid was created to capture the warmth and stillness of those in-between hours. This recipe enhances the distinctive glow of the golden hour while preserving the subtle depth and detail within the shadows. Highlights are gently softened to enrich the reflections on glass and building surfaces, while midtones and shadows maintain the city’s structure and rhythm. The color balance centers on warm orange and red tones, complemented by delicate hints of blue that convey the clarity of air and the quiet transition of time. Within the intersection of urban order and the city’s spontaneous rhythm, Golden Grid reveals both warmth and tension. It is ideal for capturing the subtle temperature of a day, whether at sunrise or sunset, when light transforms the familiar into something new.
